weather: Early October in Lisbon runs mild and mostly sunny on climate averages: high near 22C, low near 14C, skies clear-to-partly-cloudy roughly 60% of days. This is a CLIMATE AVERAGE, not a real forecast - the trip is about 4 weeks out from today (2026-09-07) and no weather service publishes a reliable day-specific forecast that far ahead.
rainChance: Climate average only: roughly 15-22% of early-October days see measurable rain in Lisbon (monthly total ~80mm). No date-specific forecast exists yet for 2026-10-04; check again inside the 10-14 day window before the trip.
moon: Waning crescent. Third Quarter was 2026-10-03, New Moon is 2026-10-10 - so the evenings of the trip (Oct 2-4) have only a thin, fairly dark sky, no bright moon to help with late viewpoint visibility after last light.

festivals.name: Festival Big Bang (Centro Cultural de Belem)
festivals.effect: Family-oriented music/arts festival held inside CCB, in the same Belem riverside district as Jeronimos Monastery, Belem Tower and the Pasteis de Belem bakery. It runs both the arrival day (Oct 2) and the following day (Oct 3) - expect extra families, ticket queues and foot traffic around CCB itself on those two days; it does not close or restrict the monastery, tower or bakery, but the surrounding streets and trams (15E) toward Belem will be busier than a normal Friday/Saturday.

festivals.name: Republic Day (Implantacao da Republica)
festivals.effect: National public holiday, the Monday immediately after the traveller departs (they leave Sunday 17:00). It turns Sat 3 - Mon 5 into a long weekend for locals, so the traveller's actual window (Fri arrival through Sun departure) sits right inside the crowd build-up: expect heavier local use of trams, miradouros and the riverfront on Saturday and especially Sunday as Lisboetas start their own long weekend. It does not close anything the traveller will see, since they are gone before the holiday itself lands.

unverified: Humidity: sources disagree sharply for Lisbon October relative humidity (65% vs 72% vs 82% seen across sites) - left null rather than averaging incompatible numbers.

Hourly temp curve and rainChance are climate normals (multi-year averages), not a day-specific forecast - true short-range forecast for 2026-10-04 does not exist yet as of today (2026-09-07); re-check inside 10-14 days of travel.

timeanddate.com sunrise/sunset page returned HTTP 403 and could not be read directly, so the second-source cross-check used generalblue.com and timebie.com instead of timeanddate; both agree with the sunrise-sunset.org API to within 1-3 minutes on sunset (19:15-19:17), which is normal rounding, not a real disagreement.

No other festival, religious observance or transport disruption specific to Oct 2-4, 2026 in Lisbon was found beyond Festival Big Bang and the run-up to Republic Day; absence of a hit is not proof none exists.
